correctness.rationale: For n→∞ first and fixed m≥4, convex distance reduces error to polygon vertices, local Poisson edge-germ spacings are independent exponentials and the chord altitude is D_m. Uniform trigonometric bounds compare D_m to δ_mXY/(X+Y) with relative O(m^-2) error. The exact tail integral P(XY/(X+Y)>z)=2ze^-2z K_1(2z) has the saddle asymptotic sqrt(pi z)e^-4z, yielding max normalization logm+(1/2)loglogm+(1/2)logpi−log2 and standard Gumbel limit. Two-sided tails provide centered uniform integrability, hence the additional Euler gamma term in the expected value. The order n then m is essential.
risks: No simultaneous n,m growth regime or nonregular polygon universality proved.
